Question: hSD01-009 AZKi's Collab Effect "Expanding Map" moved her to the back position, and the collab position is now empty. Can I Collab again this turn?

Question: For hSD01-011 AZKi's Arts "SorAZ Gravity," does the condition "If a <Tokino Sora> holomem is on your stage" still apply if there is only a hSD01-013 SorAZ on my stage?

Question: Can I use hSD01-013 SorAZ's Arts "A Future I Want to Surpass" if there are no cards in my deck or my cheer deck?

Question: Does the Extra rule on hSD01-013 SorAZ, "This holomem is also regarded as <Tokino Sora> <AZKi>" mean that even if it is somewhere other than the stage, it is treated as both Tokino Sora and AZKi?

Question: If hSD01-013 SorAZ is in the center position, and I Collab with hSD01-015 Hakui Koyori, will both of its effects activate?

Question: hSD01-017 Manager-chan says "This card can only be used if you have 1 or more cards in hand excluding this card." Does this include the case of having 1 card?

Question: hSD01-019 Amazing PC says "This card can only be used if you archive 1 cheer from your stage." Does this mean that I can archive a cheer from my cheer deck?

Question: hSD01-021 First Gravity says "This card can only be used if you have 6 or less cards in hand excluding this card." Does this include the case of having 6 cards?

Question: Does the ability of hBP01-116 Upao "when the holomem this mascot is attached to takes Damage, deal 20 Special Damage to your opponent's center holomem" also activate when this holomem takes Special Damage?
Answer: Yes, it does.

Question: Can hBP01-002 Nanashi Mumei's Oshi Skill "Guardian of Civilization" be used against Special Damage?

Question:

In this case, can I use my hBP01-002 Nanashi Mumei's Oshi Skill "Guardian of Civilization" to reduce the Special Damage by 30 and the Arts Damage by 20?
Answer: No, you cannot. The ability can only reduce the Damage from a single instance, not the two separate instances of Special Damage and Arts Damage.

Question: Can I use hBP01-003 Aki Rosenthal's Oshi Skill "Survival Power" when there are four copies of hBP01-114 Stone Axe in my Archive?

Question: One of my holomem with two green cheers attached is downed, and I use hBP01-004 Usada Pekora's Oshi Skill "Little Wild Rabbits~." In this case, can I move both cheers to only one holomem?
Answer: Yes, you can. Even if you have multiple holomem, you may choose to move all cheers to one holomem.

Question: If the results of dice rolls are already determined by hBP01-004 Usada Pekora's SP Oshi Skill "Lucky Rabbit," can the dice be treated as if they have already been rolled (i.e. can I skip rolling them)?
Answer: No, you cannot. Even if the result of a die roll is determined by an ability, the die is not considered to have been rolled until you actually roll a die.

Question: My center holomem, who has been affected by hBP01-005 Takane Lui's SP Oshi Skill "Hawkeye," received Damage equal to or greater than their remaining HP and was downed. In this case, does the downed holomem remain in the center position rather than being archived?
Answer: No, they will be archived as usual. A move refers to the process of moving between positions on the stage, so the process of a downed holomem being put in the archive is not considered a move.

Question: When using hBP01-005 Takane Lui's Oshi Skill "Female Commanding Officer," can I select cards that are in different zones, such as two cards from my hand and two from holo Power?
Answer: Yes, you can.

Question: When using hBP01-005 Takane Lui's Oshi Skill "Female Commanding Officer," can I select more cards from holo Power than I have in my hand?
Answer: Yes, you can. You can select up to as many cards as you have in your holo Power.

Question: If my collab holomem has been affected by hBP01-005 Takane Lui's SP Oshi Skill "Hawkeye," is it rested during the Reset Phase?
Answer: No, it is not. It cannot move to the back position during the Reset Phase, so it is not rested.

Question: During the turn that I use hBP01-005 Takane Lui's SP Oshi Skill "Hawkeye," can I move or swap cards using card abilities?
Answer: Yes, you can. Baton Pass, movement, and swapping is only prevented during your opponent's turn, you may move and swap as normal during your own turn.

Question: If my opponent has used hBP01-005 Takane Lui's SP Oshi Skill "Hawkeye," can I still use the effect of hBP01-066 Takanashi Kiara's Arts "Kneel Before Me."?
Answer: Yes, you can. Only the movement of holomem on stage is affected, so cards stacked to holomem are not affected by this ability.

Question: If I use hBP01-006 Takanashi Kiara's SP Oshi Skill "Rise from the Ashes," will the cheers attached to the holomem I'm putting into my hand also be put into my hand?
Answer: No, only holomems will be put into your hand. Any cheers or Support Cards attached to the holomem will be archived as usual.

Question: Can I use hBP01-006 Takanashi Kiara's Oshi Skill "Phoenix Tail" even if there are no holomems in the Archive?
Answer: Yes, you can. Holomem's and Oshi holomem's abilities can be used even if you cannot select the specified target.

Question: Can I use an effect with the text "if your holomem would take Damage" to reduce the Special Damage from hBP01-007 Hoshimachi Suisei's Oshi Skill "Comet"?
Answer: Yes, you can. For example, if you reduced that damage by 30, you would take 20 damage instead of 50.

Question: If I have multiple holomem with #ID and I use hBP01-008 Kobo Kanaeru's SP Oshi Skill "Rainmaking," can I send multiple cheers to one holomem?
Answer: Yes, you can. Even if you have multiple holomem with #ID, you may choose to send all cheers to one holomem.

Question: Can I use hBP01-008 Kobo Kanaeru's SP Oshi Skill "Rainmaking" even if there are no cheers in my archive?
Answer: Yes, you can. Holomem's and Oshi holomem's abilities can be used even if you cannot select the specified target.

Question: If my opponent has hBP01-050 Kazama Iroha's Gift "Bodyguard" active, can I use hBP01-009 Amane Kanata's Arts "KonKanata~"?
Answer:
You can declare the use of the Arts, but since you cannot properly declare a target for the Arts, it does not resolve and does not count as being used.
[Update on 2025-03-11] If hBP01-114 Stone Axe is attached to hBP01-009 Amane Kanata, the "When the holomem this tool is attached to uses Arts" ability is not activated.

Question: Does hBP01-010 Amane Kanata's Collab Effect "Angel on Adventure" also apply to Special Damage caused by an Arts' effect?
Answer: No, it does not apply.

Question: If I Bloom into hBP01-012 Amane Kanata when all of my holomem already have a mascot attached, will the Bloom Effect "Idol Kanataso" still be activated?
Answer: Yes, it will be activated. However, since there are no holomems to attach a mascot to, only check the contents of your deck and then shuffle it.

Question: If hBP01-013 Amane Kanata's Bloom Effect "Angel's Work" downs an opponent's Buzz holomem, will their Life be reduced by 2 with the Extra rules "If this holomem is downed, you get Life-2"?
Answer: No, it will not. The Extra rules "If this holomem is downed, you get Life-2" are overridden by the text "However, your opponent's Life does not reduce even if downed," so your opponent's Life does not decrease.

Question: If I down my opponent's center holomem with hBP01-014 Amane Kanata's Collab Effect "Fallen Angel," does this reduce their Life?
Answer: Yes, it does. Unless the text "However, your opponent's Life does not reduce even if downed" is present, downing a holomem with Special Damage will reduce Life.

Question: If there is a holomem on stage that activates the ability of a tool or mascot attached to them from a previous turn, when I use hBP01-015 Nanashi Mumei's Arts "Oh,Hi" does it gain the extra Damage?
Answer: No, it does not. Using a Support Card means playing one from your hand this turn.

Question: If I play hSD01-020 Circle of hololive Listeners and the die roll is 2 or less, when I use hBP01-015 Nanashi Mumei's Arts "Oh,Hi" does it gain the extra Damage?
Answer: Yes, it does. Regardless of the result of the die, the ability of the Support Card was activated, so it is considered to have been used and the damage will be gained.

Question: If a card without #Promise is revealed by hBP01-018 Nanashi Mumei's Arts "Fragments of Memories," does it still get put into my hand?
Answer: Yes, it does.

Question: Does hBP01-019 Nanashi Mumei's Bloom Effect "I Want to Sing and Dance with Everyone!" activate if it Blooms from a 1st holomem?
Answer: No, it does not.

Question: If I roll an odd number while using hBP01-023 Tokino Sora's Arts "Not gonna stop," can I use another holomem's Arts before using "Not gonna stop" again?
Answer: No, you cannot. After dealing damage, you use this Arts again immediately, so you cannot use another holomem's Arts in between.

Question: Does hBP01-026 Vestia Zeta's Bloom Effect "A New Destiny" activate if it Blooms from a 1st holomem?
Answer: No, it does not.

Question: My opponent dealt Special Damage with an ability and I did not choose to use hBP01-027 Vestia Zeta's Gift "V.7". If my opponent activates another ability that deals Special Damage this turn, can I use the Gift "V.7"?
Answer: Yes, you can. If you choose not to use an ability when you are able to, you can choose to use the ability later if the conditions are met. You can choose not to use the ability as many times as you want until you do choose to use the ability.

Question: The Extra rules for hBP01-027 Vestia Zeta state that "If this holomem is downed, you get Life-2." Does this mean that when this holomem is downed, you lose an additional 2 Life after your normal 1 Life lost, making a total of 3 Life lost?
Answer: No, the total Life lost will be 2. "If this holomem is downed, you get Life-2" is a continuous ability that overrides the normal Life you would lose.

Question: Can hBP01-027 Vestia Zeta's Gift "V.7" be used to prevent damage taken from the abilities of your own cards?
Answer: No, it cannot.

Question: Does hBP01-030 IRyS's Bloom Effect "Let's Fill the Stage with Hope!" also apply to Special Damage caused by an Arts' effect?
Answer: No, it does not apply.

Question: When I use hBP01-031 IRyS's Collab Effect "The Garden of Hope," do I have to put one card from my holo Power into my hand and put one card from the top of my Deck into my holo Power?
Answer: Yes, if you have at least one card in your holo Power then you must do this.

Question: Can I select a holomem who has full HP when using hBP01-033 Aki Rosenthal's Collab Effect "Healing Runway"?
Answer: Yes, you can. However, that holomem will not be considered as having restored HP.

Question: If my hBP01-034 Aki Rosenthal has a hBP01-114 Stone Axe attached and 10 HP remaining, when it uses an Arts and is downed, will my Life be reduced?
Answer: Yes, it will. Even if your holomem is downed by damage caused by your own card's ability, your Life will be reduced unless there is text regarding the loss of Life.

Question: My hBP01-034 Aki Rosenthal with a hBP01-114 Stone Axe attached and 10 HP remaining used an Arts, took damage from the ability of Stone Axe, and was downed. Now I have no center holomem, will I have no center holomem until my Reset Phase next turn?
Answer: No, your center holomem is reset at the End Phase of your turn. If you have any non-resting back holomem, move one of them to the center position. If you have only resting back holomem, move one of them to the center position while still resting.

Question: If my hBP01-034 Aki Rosenthal has a hBP01-114 Stone Axe attached and 10 HP remaining, when it uses an Arts, can I deal Arts damage to the opponent's holomem?
Answer: Yes, you can. If Aki Rosenthal with 10 HP remaining uses an Arts while Stone Axe is attached, after the Arts damage is dealt, the Stone Axe's "When the holomem this tool is attached to uses Arts" ability is activated and Aki Rosenthal will take 10 damage and be downed.

Question: If my hBP01-034 Aki Rosenthal has a hBP01-114 Stone Axe and a hBP01-119 Jobs attached, and 10 HP remaining, when it uses an Arts, can I deal Arts damage to the opponent's holomem?
Answer:
Yes, you can. After declaring the use of Arts, the abilities of both Stone Axe and Jobs are triggered at the same time and go into standby. After the process of dealing Arts damage is completed, the order of resolution of the abilities in standby is chosen.
If you activate the ability of Jobs first to restore 10 HP, and then deal 10 damage with the ability of Stone Axe, Aki Rosenthal will not be downed.

Question: When using hBP01-035 Aki Rosenthal's Arts "AkiRose Fantasia" to send a cheer, can I choose which holomem to send the cheer to after checking the color of the cheer?
Answer: Yes, you can. Turn over the top card of your cheer deck, then choose a holomem to send it to.

Question: Can I use hBP01-035 Aki Rosenthal's Arts "AkiRose Fantasia" even if there are no cards in my cheer deck?
Answer: Yes, you can.

Question: Can I select a holomem who has full HP when using hBP01-036 Aki Rosenthal's Collab Effect "Rose Knights, Cheer for Me!"?
Answer: Yes, you can. However, that holomem will not be considered as having restored HP.

Question: While using hBP01-037 Aki Rosenthal's Bloom Effect "Gothic Doll," I was unable to send a cheer because there were no cards in my cheer deck. In this case, can I still restore HP?
Answer: Yes, you can.

Question: Can hBP01-037 Aki Rosenthal's Bloom Effect "Gothic Doll" be used to send cheer, even if that holomem is at full HP?
Answer: Yes, it can.

Question: Can hBP01-039 Usada Pekora's Collab Effect "Galaxy Idol" be used and a die rolled, even if there are no cards in the cheer deck?
Answer: Yes, it can.

Question: Can hBP01-045 AZKi Bloom into a 1st holomem even if I have 3 Life or less remaining, and the effect of its Gift "Overwrite" is active?
Answer: Yes, she can. The ability of the Gift "Overwrite" allows you to Bloom into a 2nd holomem, but you can also Bloom into a 1st holomem as usual.

Question: hBP01-045 AZKi's Gift "Overwrite" says "While your Life is 3 or less." Does this include the case of having 3 Life?
Answer: Yes, it does.

Question: Can I reattach the cheers selected with hBP01-046 AZKi's Bloom Effect "Because All the Pioneers Were There" to the holomem that it was originally attached to?
Answer: No. If the holomem that the cheer is currently attached to and the holomem you want to move it to are the same, nothing happens.

Question: Can I roll a die when hBP01-047 AZKi's Bloom Effect "The Path Life has Taken" is activated, even if it is at full HP?
Answer: Yes, you can.

Question: If I have no cheers in my archive, can I still use hBP01-047 AZKi's Bloom Effect "The Path Life has Taken" to restore HP?
Answer: Yes, you can.

Question: When using hBP01-050 Kazama Iroha's Arts "Bringing You Energy at Full Power!" to send a cheer, can I choose which holomem to send the cheer to after checking the color of the cheer?
