Question: Can I use hBP01-050 Kazama Iroha's Arts "Bringing You Energy at Full Power!" even if there are no cards in my cheer deck?
Answer: Yes, you can.

Question: Can I use hBP01-054 Airani Iofifteen's Bloom Effect "The Sea of Green Light" to send a cheer to an Airani Iofifteen other than the one that Bloomed?
Answer: No, you cannot.

Question: Does the "1 cheer each" in hBP01-055 Airani Iofifteen's Collab Effect "AREA 15" mean 1 cheer of each color?
Answer: No, it means you can only send 1 cheer to each holomem you target. You may choose any number of cheers of the same color for the effect.

Question: Do I have to choose only one type of cheer to send with hBP01-055 Airani Iofifteen's Collab Effect "AREA 15"?
Answer: No, you may choose any number of types of cheer.

Question: If my opponent has no collab holomem, can I use hBP01-057 Takane Lui's Arts "I'll Lure You in with Wings Darker than Black"?
Answer: Yes, you can. Only Arts Damage will be dealt, as the effect has no target and will not resolve.

Question: Does hBP01-060 Takane Lui's Bloom Effect "It's All Thanks to You Guys!!" activate if it Blooms from a 1st holomem?
Answer: No, it does not.

Question: Can I choose not to use hBP01-061 Takane Lui's Bloom Effect "Organization Command Center" to put any cards into my hand, even if there are holomem in my archive that I can put into my hand?
Answer: Yes, you can. The ability says "You may return 1~2 holomem ... to hand" so you can choose not to put any into hand.

Question: Does hBP01-061 Takane Lui's Arts "Hawk Rave" require at least one card to be archived?
Answer: No, you may choose not to archive any cards.

Question: Can I use hBP01-065 Takanashi Kiara's Bloom Effect "Let's do this!!!!" when there are 2 or less cards in my Deck?
Answer: Yes, you can. In this case, the number of cards you see will be reduced, but otherwise perform the effect as normal.

Question: When I use hBP01-066 Takanashi Kiara's Arts "Kneel Before Me." can I archive that holomem?
Answer: No, you cannot. You can only archive holomems stacked to that one.

Question: hBP01-066 Takanashi Kiara's Arts "Kneel Before Me." allows you to archive "1 holomem that is stacked to this holomem." Which cards can I archive?
Answer: This effect can only archive holomem stacked under that card, that are not that card. For example, if you Bloomed from a Debut holomem to this holomem, you may only use this ability once.

Question: What happens if I try to use hBP01-067 Takanashi Kiara's Arts "Majestic Phoenix" to "return 6 holomem from your archive to deck" when there are only 5 holomem in my archive?
Answer: Deal 130 damage to the opponent's holomem, then shuffle those 5 cards into your deck. You should resolve any ability's effects as much as possible.

Question: Does hBP01-074 Hakos Baelz's Bloom Effect "The Rat Idol Finally Appears!" activate if it Blooms from a 1st holomem?
Answer: No, it does not.

Question: Can I use hBP01-075 Hakos Baelz's Collab Effect "Chaos Shuffle" if my opponent has no cards in their hand and I have at least 1 card in my hand?
Answer: Yes, you can. Even if one player has no cards in their hand, if there is a player that has at least 1 card in their hand that player will resolve the effect.

Question: My hBP01-081 Hoshimachi Suisei is the third card in the stack (it is stacked on top of a Debut holomem and a 1st holomem). When I use the Arts "Shining Comet" and archive 2 blue cheers, will the Damage dealt to the opponent's holomem be 180 or 240?
Answer: It will deal 180 Damage. Since there are two cards stacked under the top holomem, 120 Damage will be added onto the Arts' base Damage of 60.

Question: Can hBP01-083 Kobo Kanaeru's Collab Effect "Take Kobo to the Sea!" be used and a die rolled, even if there are no cards in the cheer deck?
Answer: Yes, it can.

Question: Can the effect of hBP01-085 Kobo Kanaeru's Arts "Raindrops" still be used even if my opponent only has 2 or fewer back holomem?
Answer: Yes, it can. If your opponent has 2 or fewer back holomem, deal 10 Special Damage to all of them.

Question: Will the Bloom Effect of the holomem who was Bloomed by hBP01-095 Ouro Kronii's Arts "Fast Forward" be activated?
Answer:
Yes, it will be activated.
However, the ability of the Bloom Effect is put into standby, and waits until after the Arts has completely resolved as this is when the next Check Timing occurs.

Question: Can hBP01-095 Ouro Kronii's Collab Effect "Rewind" be used on a holomem that is not stacked on a Debut holomem?
Answer: Yes, though if you target a holomem that is not stacked on a Debut holomem the effect cannot resolve normally, so it ends without doing anything.

Question: hBP01-102 Idol Microphone says "This card can only be used if you have 6 or less cards in hand excluding this card." Does this include the case of having 6 cards?
Answer: Yes, it does.

Question: If I use hBP01-104 Normal PC and the card I want isn't in the deck, can I choose not to reveal any card even if there are other Debut holomems in the deck?
Answer: Yes, you can. In that case, shuffle the deck and the ability ends.

Question: Can I use hBP01-105 Penlight if there are only Spot holomem on my stage?
Answer: Yes you can. However, since there are no holomem with any color on your stage, you archive one holo Power and Penlight without sending any cheer.

Question: If I use hBP01-105 Penlight when there is only a hSD01-013 SorAZ on my stage, can I choose either a white or green cheer?
Answer: Yes, you can choose either. SorAZ is a card that can be treated as either white or green, so for any abilities that refer to its color, you may choose either color.

Question: Can I use hBP01-107 Encore even if there are no cheers in my archive?
Answer: No, you cannot. Support Cards cannot be used if you cannot select the specified target and using them does not change the game state other than putting the Support Card in the archive.

Question: hBP01-109 Tale of the Moon and the Rabbit says "This card can only be used if you have 6 or less cards in hand excluding this card." Does this include the case of having 6 cards?
Answer: Yes, it does.

Question:
If my oshi holomem is hBP01-002 Nanashi Mumei and I use the card hBP01-110 I'll smack you with a blunt weapon! for its Ability Shift, will only the "Archive 2 of your opponent's center holomem's cheers" part of the effect activate?
Or will the "Roll a die once:If it is 3 or less, archive 1 of your opponent's holomem's cheers" part also activate?
Answer: The effect is completely changed to the "Archive 2 of your opponent's center holomem's cheers" part. There is no need to roll a die and get a result of 3 or less.

Question: hBP01-111 hololive Indonesia Gen 3 says "This card can only be used if you have 6 or less cards in hand excluding this card." Does this include the case of having 6 cards?
Answer: Yes, it does.

Question: hBP01-113 Promise says "This card can only be used if you have 6 or less cards in hand excluding this card." Does this include the case of having 6 cards?
Answer: Yes, it does.

Question: Does hBP01-114 Stone Axe's ability "The holomem this tool is attached to gets Arts+20" also apply to Special Damage caused by an Arts' effect?
Answer: No, it does not apply.

Question: Does hBP01-116 Upao's ability "The holomem this mascot is attached to gets Arts+10" also apply to Special Damage caused by an Arts' effect?
Answer: No, it does not apply.

Question: Is hBP01-118 Ankimo always treated as a cheer when it is attached to a holomem?
Answer: No, it is only treated as a cheer when checking the conditions for using an Arts. At all other times, it is treated as a Support Card attached to the holomem.

Question: If I only have 1 Life, and my hBP01-013 Amane Kanata with a hBP01-116 Upao attached is damaged by an opponent's Arts and is downed, can I use Upao's ability to deal Special Damage to the opponent's holomem?
Answer: No, damage is not dealt. When your holomem's HP reaches 0, the "Down Process" rule is performed and your Life reaches 0, so you immediately lose before you can use Upao's ability from standby.

Question: Does hBP01-117 Friend's ability "The holomem this mascot is attached to gets Arts+10" also apply to Special Damage caused by an Arts' effect?
Answer: No, it does not apply.

Question: Does hBP01-115 Hoshimachi Suisei's Microphone's ability "The holomem this tool is attached to gets Arts+10" also apply to Special Damage caused by an Arts' effect?
Answer: No, it does not apply.

Question: Can I select a holomem who has full HP when using hBP01-119 Jobs' ability "When the holomem this mascot is attached to uses Arts, restore 10 HP to 1 of your holomem"?
Answer: Yes, you can. However, that holomem will not be considered as having restored HP.

Question: Does hBP01-120 Ganmo's ability "The holomem this mascot is attached to gets Arts+10" also apply to Special Damage caused by an Arts' effect?
Answer: No, it does not apply.

Question: If I Bloom a 1st hBP01-065 Takanashi Kiara that has hBP01-121 Kotori attached, into a 1st hBP01-066 Takanashi Kiara, can I use Kotori's ability "When the Bloom level of the holomem this mascot is attached to increases, draw 1 card from your deck"?
Answer: No, you cannot. Increasing Bloom level means going from a Debut holomem to a 1st holomem, or from a 1st holomem to a 2nd holomem. If you Bloom to the same Bloom level, it is not considered an increase of Bloom level.

Question: Is hBP01-126 Troupe Member always treated as a cheer when it is attached to a holomem?
Answer: No, it is only treated as a cheer when checking the conditions for using an Arts. At all other times, it is treated as a Support Card attached to the holomem.

Question: If I have 6 holomem on my stage, can I use hBP01-104 Normal PC?
Answer: No, you cannot.

Question: If I Bloom a hSD01-013 SorAZ that has hBP01-124 Pioneers attached, into a hBP01-023 Tokino Sora, does the Pioneers stay attached?
Answer: No, it does not. The Pioneers will be archived.

Question: If I use hBP01-108 So, That Makes You My Enemy, which player chooses the back holomem that is swapped into the center position?
Answer: The player who used the card So, That Makes You My Enemy chooses.

Question: If I use hSD01-001 Tokino Sora's SP Oshi Skill "So, that Makes You My Enemy?" which player chooses the back holomem that is swapped into the center position?
Answer: The player who used the skill So, that Makes You My Enemy? chooses.

Question: When drawing 7 cards from the deck at the start of the game, if I have a Debut holomem in my hand, am I required to start the game with that hand?
Answer: No, regardless of whether you have a Debut holomem, you may choose to mulligan once. If you mulligan, return all cards to the deck, shuffle, and draw 7 new cards.

Question: What happens if I draw 7 cards at the start of the game and there is no Debut holomem in my hand?
Answer: If no Debut holomem is drawn in the initial 7 cards, you must mulligan. Without revealing the hand to your opponent, return all cards to the deck, shuffle, and draw 7 new cards.

Question: What happens if, after my first mulligan, I still don't have a Debut holomem in my hand?
Answer:
After redrawing your hand, if you still don't have a Debut holomem, reveal all cards in your hand, return them to the deck and shuffle, then draw 7 cards, repeating until you have a Debut holomem.

Once you have a Debut holomem, choose 1 Debut holomem in your hand and place it face down in the center position. Then, for each time you redrew (other than the initial redraw), put one card from your hand on the bottom of your deck, placing those cards in any order you like.

Question:
During game preparation, after the initial redraw, I performed six more redraws, but I still didn't have a Debut holomem in my hand.

If I perform a seventh redraw, I will put seven cards on the bottom of the deck, resulting in having no holomem to place in the center position. What happens in this case?
Answer: Excluding the first redraw, if a player has redrawn six times, that player loses.

Question: Can a Spot holomem be placed in the center position at the start of the game?
Answer: No, only a Debut holomem can be placed in the center position when starting the game.

Question: After placing a Debut holomem in the center position, am I required to place any remaining Debut holomem in the back position?
Answer: No, you are not required to place them. You may choose any number of remaining Debut holomem from your hand to place in the back position, but it is not mandatory.

Question: If multiple holomem are resting during the Reset Phase, is there an order in which they are unrested?
Answer: There is no particular order. If multiple holomem are resting, they are all unrested simultaneously.

Question: During my turn, my center holomem was downed. Now I have no center holomem, will I have no center holomem until my Reset Phase next turn?
Answer: No, your center holomem is reset at the End Phase of your turn. If you have any non-resting back holomem, move one of them to the center position. If you have only resting back holomem, move one of them to the center position while still resting.

Question: Can a resting holomem be moved to the center position during the Reset Phase?
Answer: If there is a non-resting holomem on your stage, you must prioritize moving a non-resting holomem to the center position. If all of your holomem are resting, you move one of your resting holomem to the center position while still resting.

Question: What happens if I cannot draw a card during the Draw Phase because my deck has no cards?
Answer: If you cannot draw a card from the deck during the Draw Phase, you lose the game.

Question: Can the player going first draw a card from their deck during their first turn's Draw Phase?
Answer: Yes, they can.

Question: Can the player going first send a cheer to one of their holomem during their first turn's Cheer Phase?
Answer: Yes, they can.

Question: During the Cheer Phase, when sending a cheer from the top of the cheer deck, can I choose which holomem to send the cheer to after checking the color of the cheer?
Answer: Yes, you can. Turn over the top card of your cheer deck, then choose a holomem to send it to.

Question: Can I choose to archive a cheer instead of choosing a holomem to send it to after revealing the card during the Cheer Phase?
Answer: No, you cannot. After revealing the cheer, you must choose a holomem to send it to.

Question: What happens if there are no cards in my cheer deck during the Cheer Phase?
Answer: If there are no cards left, you cannot send any cheer and proceed to the next phase.

Question: Can only one Debut or Spot holomem be placed on the stage per turn?
Answer: No, you can place as many as you want. However, excluding your Oshi holomem, the total number of holomem on the stage (center, collab, and back positions combined) is limited to six.

Question: Can only one Support Card be used per turn?
Answer: No, you can use as many as you want per turn. However, you can only use one Support Card marked "Limited" per turn, even if they have different names.

Question: Can the player going first use a Support Card marked "Limited" during their first turn?
Answer: No, they cannot. Support Cards marked "Limited" can only be used starting from the first turn of the player going second.

Question: Can a holomem that was just placed on the stage Bloom during the same turn?
Answer: No, it cannot. A holomem that was just placed on the stage cannot Bloom during that turn. Additionally, during both players' first turns of the game, no holomem can Bloom.

Question: If I have two Debut holomem that can Bloom on my stage, can I Bloom them both in the same turn?
Answer: Yes, you can. If you have multiple holomem that can Bloom, you can Bloom each of them.

Question: Can a Spot holomem Bloom?
Answer: No, it cannot.

Question: Can a 1st holomem Bloom into another 1st holomem, or a 2nd holomem into another 2nd holomem?
Answer: Yes, they can. A holomem can Bloom into another holomem with the same or one higher Bloom level (but cannot Bloom into a Debut holomem).

Question: Can a 1st Buzz holomem Bloom into a 1st holomem?
Answer: Yes, it can. Since Buzz holomem are treated as their written Bloom level, they can Bloom into a 1st holomem. The reverse is also possible.

Question: Can I Baton Pass multiple times in one turn?
Answer: No, you cannot. Baton Pass can only be performed once per turn.

Question: When performing a Baton Pass, do both holomems being swapped need to archive a cheer?
Answer: No, only the center holomem needs to archive the number of cheers specified to Baton Pass.

Question: Can I Baton Pass if my center holomem is resting?
Answer: No, you cannot. Both the center and back holomem must be non-resting to Baton Pass.

Question: Can my collab holomem Baton Pass to swap with one of my back holomem?
Answer: No, it cannot. Only the center holomem can Baton Pass.

Question: Can the player going first Collab during their first turn?
Answer: Yes, they can.

Question: Can the player going first's center or collab holomem use Arts during their first turn?
Answer: No, they cannot. Arts can only be used starting from the first turn of the player going second.

Question: If the opponent has no collab holomem, can I use an Arts with an effect that that targets the opponent's collab holomem?
Answer: Yes, you can. Only Arts damage will be dealt, as the effect has no target and will not resolve.

Question: Can my center holomem use an Arts during the Performance Step if it is resting?
Answer: No, it cannot. A resting holomem cannot use Arts.

Question: When one of my holomem is downed and my Life is reduced, can I choose not to send a cheer from my Life to a holomem and archive it instead?
Answer: No, you cannot. You must select a holomem and send the cheer to it.

Question: What happens if my holomem is downed, and no holomem other than my Oshi holomem remains on my stage?
Answer: If no other holomem remain on your stage except your Oshi holomem, you lose the game.

Question: During my turn, my center holomem was downed. Now I have no center holomem, do I immediately move a holomem from my back position to my center position?
Answer: No, your center holomem is set at the End Phase of your turn. At that point, if you have any non-resting back holomem, move one of them to the center position. If you have only resting back holomem, move one of them to the center position while still resting.

Question: When reducing Life after a holomem is downed, can I choose any Life card to turn over and send to a holomem?
Answer: No, when reducing Life, you must turn over and send the top Life card first.

Question: What happens if both players' holomem are downed at the same time, and both players' Life totals reach zero simultaneously?
Answer: If both players' Life totals reach zero at exactly the same time, the game ends in a draw.

Question: Is there a hand size limit?
Answer: No, there is no limit to the number of cards you can have in your hand.

Question: When consuming holo Power, can I choose which holo Power to archive?
Answer: No, you cannot. You must archive the top holo Power first.

Question: Can I use my SP Oshi Skill on the same turn as my Oshi Skill?
Answer: Yes, you can. If you can afford the holo Power, you can use your Oshi Skill and SP Oshi Skill on the same turn.

Question: Can the ability to "reduce Damage" be used to reduce Special Damage?
Answer: Yes, it can. The term "Damage" refers to both Arts Damage and Special Damage. The ability may apply to either type of Damage, and the effect will reduce the Damage accordingly.

Question: When a Buzz holomem with the Extra rules "If this holomem is downed, you get Life-2" is downed, do I turn over and send 2 Life cards to my holomem simultaneously?
Answer: No, it is not processed simultaneously. When Life is reduced by 2 or more, you repeat the process of turning one Life card over and sending it to a holomem for each reduced Life point.

Question: If both my holomem A and holomem B are downed simultaneously due to the opponent's card effect, how should I process this?
Answer:
Process it in the following order:
1. As part of holomem A's down process, execute any "when this holomem is downed" abilities, and any of your opponent's "when you down your opponent's holomem" abilities.
2. Archive holomem A and take 1 life by turning the top card of your life over and sending it to a holomem.
3. As part of holomem B's down process, execute any "when this holomem is downed" abilities, and any of your opponent's "when you down your opponent's holomem" abilities.
4. Archive holomem B and take 1 life by turning the top card of your life over and sending it to a holomem.

Question: What should I do if I think my opponent's shuffling is insufficient?
Answer: Ask your opponent to shuffle thoroughly and have them shuffle again. If they still do not shuffle sufficiently, call a judge or tournament staff and follow their instructions.

Question: What should I do if I accidentally forget something I need to do during a tournament (like archiving a holomem due to Down processing)?
Answer:
Stop the game immediately and inform a judge or tournament staff. Then follow their instructions.
If you continue playing with the mistake and it becomes an irreversible situation, you might end up being given a game loss, so notify a judge or tournament staff as soon as you realize.

Question: What should I do if me and my opponent disagree about rules during a tournament?
Answer:
Stop the game immediately and inform a judge or tournament staff. Follow their instructions afterward. Informing them after the outcome has been determined cannot change the result and may cause further issues.
If there is a discrepancy in the rules as understood by your opponent, confirm with them first and then inform the judge/tournament staff.

Question: What is a Collab Effect?
Answer: A Collab Effect is an automatic ability that requires a holomem to collab. If an ability is a "Collab Effect," it means "when this holomem is placed in the collab position, perform this effect."

Question: What is a Bloom Effect?
Answer: A Bloom Effect is an automatic ability that requires a holomem to Bloom. If an ability is a "Bloom Effect," it means "when Blooming into this card, perform this effect."

Question: What is a Gift?
Answer: Gift is a keyword possessed by certain persistent abilities.

Question: What is Arts Damage?
Answer: Arts Damage refers to the Damage that the Arts inflicts on the opponent's holomem, indicated on the right side of the Arts' name. Damage dealt by the abilities of Arts or Support Cards is considered Special Damage, not Arts Damage.

Question: What is Special Damage?
Answer: Special Damage refers to Damage dealt by abilities written on Arts or by Support Cards, etc.

Question: If an ability says "Damage," does it refer to Arts Damage or Special Damage?
Answer: Damage refers to both Arts Damage and Special Damage. If there are conditions like "when this holomem takes Damage," they activate whether it is Arts Damage or Special Damage taken.

Question: Is my Oshi holomem counted as a holomem on the stage?
Answer: No, your Oshi holomem is not counted as a holomem on the stage.

Question: Can I freely rearrange the order of cheers and Support Cards attached to a holomem?
Answer: Yes, you can freely rearrange them. However, the holomem at the top of a stack of holomem must always be placed on top of the pile, and their order cannot be changed.

Question: If a holomem has multiple colors, how should it be treated? For example, is a card with both White and Green colors considered a "White-Green" card?
Answer: It is treated as both a White card and a Green card. The color "White-Green" does not exist.

Question: Can a Debut holomem Bloom into another Debut holomem?
Answer: No, it cannot.

Question: Can a holomem Bloom into another holomem with the same card number?
Answer: Yes, it can.

Question: Can a 1st holomem Bloom into another 1st holomem or a 1st Buzz holomem?
Answer: Yes, it can Bloom into either. Except when special effect text states otherwise, a holomem can Bloom into another holomem of the same Bloom level or one level higher.

Question: When a resting holomem is Bloomed, does it become non-resting?
Answer: No, the Bloomed holomem inherits the state of the original holomem, so it remains resting.

Question: If a holomem's ability says "draw 1 card from your deck," can I choose not to draw the card?
Answer: No, you cannot choose not to draw. You can only choose not to resolve an effect if the text states "you may".

Question: If an ability says "you may" can I choose not to activate it?
Answer: Yes, you can choose not to activate it. You can only choose not to activate an ability if the text states "you may".

Question: Can I Bloom a Debut holomem into a 1st holomem with lower HP?
Answer: Yes, you can. A holomem can Bloom into another holomem with lower HP than their current maximum HP. However, it cannot Bloom into a holomem with HP lower than the damage already received.

Question: When a Support Card is used, is it archived before resolving the text written on the card?
Answer: No, it is not. When a Support Card is used, it is temporarily placed in the resolution area. The written text is resolved, and then the card is archived.

Question: Are there rules for the order in which to place holo Power?
Answer: When placing new holo Power, please ensure it is placed in a way that makes it clear it is newer than the already placed cards. You may not change the order except if an ability lets you do so.

Question: Are there rules for the order in which holo Power is archived when using Oshi Skills, SP Oshi Skills, etc.?
Answer: When archiving holo Power, you must archive from the top card. You cannot freely choose which cards to archive.

Question: After looking at holo Power through an ability, can I rearrange the order when returning them?
Answer: No, after confirming the contents of holo Power and performing the specified actions like putting any into your hand, you must return them in the original order they were placed. You cannot change the order when returning, even if the number of holo Powers has not changed.

Question: Are there rules for the order in which to place Life?
Answer: When placing Life, place them one by one from the top of the cheer deck in a way that the order is clear. You may not change the order except if an ability lets you do so.

Question: When reducing Life when a holomem is downed, can I freely choose which card to turn over and send to a holomem?
Answer: No, you must always turn the top card face up and send it to your holomem.

Question: If an ability that deals Special Damage and an ability that heals the same holomem are triggered simultaneously, and the damage exceeds that holomem's current HP, is that holomem downed before healing?
Answer: Yes, it will be downed. If the HP of a holomem reaches 0 at the end of one ability's activation, the "Down processing" rule will take priority over any other abilities.

Question: Is there a hand size limit?
Answer: No, there is no limit to the number of cards you can have in your hand.

Question: Can I rearrange the order of cards in my hand?
Answer: Yes, you can.

Question: When an ability says "draw 1 card from your deck," can I draw from the top of the cheer deck?
Answer: No, you cannot. Unless specified otherwise, you draw the specified number from the top of your main deck.

Question: Can I change the order of cards in my archive?
Answer: Yes, you can rearrange your archive freely, so long as you do it in a way that your opponent can verify the contents are unchanged.

Question: Does the text of an Arts activate before dealing Arts Damage?
Answer: Yes, when you declare the use of the Arts, the abilities in the Arts' text activate, and then you deal Arts Damage.

Question: If I use an Arts and its text deals Special Damage greater than the opposing holomem's remaining HP before dealing Arts Damage, will the opponent's holomem be downed immediately?
Answer: Yes, it will be downed.

Question: If I deal Damage greater than the remaining HP of an opponent's holomem with an Arts, can that holomem restore HP with an ability that triggers "when this holomem takes Damage"?
Answer: No, it cannot restore HP. After resolving the effect of an ability, if the Damage exceeds remaining HP, the "Down processing" rule occurs immediately. The recovery ability in standby cannot restore HP because the target holomem will no longer be on the stage due to the Down processing.

Question: Can I Collab when my deck has no cards?
Answer: No, you cannot. You must have at least 1 card in your deck, and it must be possible to send a card from your deck to your holo Power.

Question: If an ability with "draw 1 card from your deck" triggers while my deck has no cards and I cannot draw a card, do I immediately lose the game?
Answer: No, you do not lose. You only lose the game if you cannot draw a card during your Draw Phase.

Question: When a Buzz holomem has Extra rules that state "If this holomem is downed, you get Life-2," does this mean that when this holomem is downed, you lose an additional 2 Life after your normal 1 Life lost, making a total of 3 Life lost?
Answer: No, the total Life lost will be 2. "If this holomem is downed, you get Life-2" is a continuous ability that overrides the normal Life you would lose.

Question: Does the condition "If a <Name A> holomem is on your stage" still apply if there is only a holomem with the Extra rules "This holomem is also regarded as <Name A> <Name B>" on my stage?
Answer: Yes, it does meet the condition. Even if there is no other card with the specified name on the stage, the Extra rule states that "This holomem is also regarded as <Name A> <Name B>" so it meets the condition.

Question: Is there a limit to the number of holomem that can be on my stage?
Answer: Excluding your Oshi holomem, you can have a total of up to 6 holomem on your stage, including center, collab, and back positions.

Question: If I down my opponent's center holomem with an effect that deals Special Damage, does this reduce their Life?
Answer: Yes, it does. Unless the text "However, your opponent's Life does not reduce even if downed" is present, downing a holomem with Special Damage will reduce Life.

Question: During which Phase are Oshi Skills and SP Oshi Skills used?
Answer: If there is no trigger stated, they are used during your Main Phase. If there is a trigger condition such as "Usable if your holomem's ability would roll a die," the Skill can be activated at that time.

Question: When using hBP01-108 So, That Makes You My Enemy, when swapping my opponent's center holomem with one of their back holomem, can I choose a holomem that is resting?
Answer: Yes, you can.

Question: Can I use hBP01-108 So, That Makes You My Enemy if my opponent has no center holomem, or no back holomem?
Answer: No, you cannot. If you cannot choose a target and this results in the effect being unable to resolve, you cannot use a Support Card.

Question: When using hSD01-001 Tokino Sora's SP Oshi Skill "So, that Makes You My Enemy?", when switching my opponent's center holomem with one of their back holomem, can I choose a holomem that is resting?
Answer: Yes, you can.

Question: Can I use hSD01-001 Tokino Sora's SP Oshi Skill "So, that Makes You My Enemy?" if my opponent has no center holomem, or no back holomem?
Answer: Yes, you can. To resolve the effect as much as possible, the part "Swap your opponent's center holomem with 1 back holomem" will not be resolved, only the part "During this turn, your white center holomem gets Arts+50" will be resolved.

Question: When using hBP01-081 Hoshimachi Suisei's Arts "Shining Comet," does the text "(This Arts can target your opponent's back holomem too)" still apply even if I do not pay the cost of "archive 2 blue cheers from this holomem"?
Answer: No, you cannot target a back holomem with the Arts. If the cost in a text is not paid, the effects of all text after it will not be activated, so you may only target your opponent's center or collab holomem.

Question: I used an Arts with both hBP01-114 Stone Axe and hBP01-126 Troupe Member attached to my holomem. When that holomem takes 10 Special Damage from the effect of Stone Axe, does Troupe Member's effect "The holomem this fan is attached to takes +10 Damage" apply?
Answer: Yes, it applies and the holomem takes a total of 20 damage.

Question:
A hBP01-079 Hoshimachi Suisei with a hBP01-115 Hoshimachi Suisei's Microphone attached to it downed an opponent's holomem with the Special Damage from its Bloom Effect.
Does this meet the condition "If the holomem this tool is attached to downed your opponent's holomem" on Hoshimachi Suisei's Microphone?
Answer: Yes, the condition is met.

Question: With holomem A in the center position, I used hSD01-004 Tokino Sora's Collab Effect "Let's Dance!" to give it Arts+20. If I then Bloom holomem A to holomem B, will it still have Arts+20?
Answer: Yes, it will still have Arts+20. All effects such as this will carry through Bloom.

Question: After using hBP01-010 Amane Kanata's Collab Effect "Angel on Adventure" to increase the Arts Damage of the center holomem, if that Kanata Blooms into another holomem will the effect of increased Arts Damage still apply?
Answer: Yes, it will continue to be in effect.

Question: I have one IRyS in my center position and one IRyS in my collab position. If I Bloom each of them to hBP01-030 IRyS, will the Bloom Effect "Let's Fill the Stage with Hope!" be activated two times, giving my center and collab holomem both a total of Arts+60?
Answer: Yes, the effects will stack and Arts Damage will be increased by 60.

Question: My opponent rolled a die as part of hBP01-023 Tokino Sora's Arts "Not gonna stop" and the result was odd, allowing them to use the Arts once more. If I have hBP01-027 Vestia Zeta in my collab position, when can I use her Gift "V.7"?
Answer:
You may choose to use this ability on either the first or second time your holomem takes damage from "Not gonna stop".

■If you choose to use this ability the first time your holomem takes Damage: when your holomem would take Damage for the first time, roll the die according to "V.7" and resolve the effects that follow.
When your holomem takes Damage for the second time, you have already used the ability, so the 1/Turn restriction applies and your holomem must take the Damage.

■If you choose to use this ability the second time your holomem takes Damage: when your holomem takes Damage for the first time, do not roll the die or activate "V.7", and take the Damage.
When your holomem would take Damage for the second time, roll the die according to "V.7" and resolve the effects that follow.

Question:
I have no back holomem on my stage, only a center holomem and a collab holomem. When I damage my opponent's holomem with my center holomem's Arts, my center holomem is downed and gets archived due to the ability of an hBP01-116 Upao attached to my opponent's holomem.
What should I do if I have no center or back holomem at my End Phase?
Answer: You should pass the turn to your opponent without setting a center holomem, leaving only your collab holomem on the stage.

Question: What should I do if I have no center or back holomem at my End Phase?
Answer: You should pass the turn to your opponent without setting a center holomem, leaving only your collab holomem on the stage.

Question: If a holomem uses a Collab Effect, can they use another Collab Effect when they Bloom?
Answer: No, you cannot use a Collab Effect when you Bloom, as it requires moving to the collab position and adding holo Power.

Question:
When using hBP01-081 Hoshimachi Suisei's Arts "Shining Comet" I reduced the HP of my opponent's center holomem to 0.
If I then want to use hBP01-007 Hoshimachi Suisei's SP Oshi Skill "Shooting Star" which do I deal with first, my opponent sending a cheer from their Life or the Skill "Shooting Star"?
Answer: A holomem will be downed as soon as their HP reaches 0, so first the cheer is sent from Life and then the Skill "Shooting Star" can be used.

Question:
When using hBP01-081 Hoshimachi Suisei's Arts "Shining Comet" I reduced the HP of the opponent's center holomem to 0. My opponent is using hBP01-004 Usada Pekora as their Oshi holomem.
If I then want to use hBP01-007 Hoshimachi Suisei's SP Oshi Skill "Shooting Star" and my opponent wants to use Usada Pekora's Oshi Skill "Little Wild Rabbits~", which one do we deal with first?
Answer: When a holomem's HP reaches 0, the Down process is performed, during which the Oshi Skill "Little Wild Rabbits~" can be used then cheer is sent from Life. After that is complete, you can use the Skill "Shooting Star".

Question: Can I Bloom my collab holomem?
Answer: Yes, you can.

Question: If a holomem uses a Collab Effect, can they use another Collab Effect when they Bloom?
Answer: No, you cannot use a Collab Effect when you Bloom, as it requires moving to the collab position and adding holo Power.

Question: After moving my center holomem to the back position using Baton Pass, can it Collab or Bloom?
Answer: Yes, it can.

Question:
My opponent used hBP01-005 Takane Lui's SP Oshi Skill "Hawkeye", and I had no center or back holomem at the start of my turn, only a collab holomem.
In this case, can I proceed without moving a holomem to the center position during the Reset Phase?
Answer: Yes, you proceed with your turn without a center holomem.

Question:
My Oshi holomem is hSD01-002 AZKi, and when one of my holomem would take damage I choose to use hBP01-027 Vestia Zeta's Gift "V.7".
In this case, can I declare the number that will be rolled using AZKi's Oshi Skill "A Map in My Left Hand"?
Answer: Yes, you can.

Question: For cards other than my Oshi holomem that say "1/Turn", can I only use one of these abilities during my turn, even if I have multiple cards with the same card number?
Answer: No, even if the card number is the same, if the card says "1/Turn" you may use each card's ability once on each turn.

Question: Can I use the ability of hBP01-105 Penlight to choose a red holomem, and then send a red cheer from my cheer deck to a blue holomem?
Answer: Yes, you can.

Question: Can I use hBP01-094 Ouro Kronii's Bloom Effect "Kronii-Chiwa!" to choose a red holomem, and then send a red cheer from my cheer deck to a blue holomem?
Answer: Yes, you can.

Question: If my hBP01-034 Aki Rosenthal with a hBP01-114 Stone Axe attached, is healed by hBP01-037 Aki Rosenthal's Bloom Effect "Gothic Doll", can I draw a card with Stone Axe's ability?
Answer: Yes, you can.

Question: Does hBP01-023 Tokino Sora's Art "Not gonna stop" deal damage multiplied by the number of times an odd number is rolled on the die?
Answer: No. Arts damage is dealt once after the die is rolled, and if the result is odd then the Arts may be used again, so damage is not dealt all at once.

Question: What is the difference between "when this holomem takes Damage" and "when this holomem would take Damage"?
Answer: "When this holomem takes Damage" is when your HP is reduced due to Arts Damage etc., "when this holomem would take Damage" is when you are about to take Damage from Arts Damage etc.

Question: My Buzz holomem took 50 more damage than their remaining HP from my opponent's hBP01-014 Amane Kanata's Arts "Wings Darker than Black". How much Life damage will I take?
Answer: Since the condition of Amane Kanata's ability "Wings Darker than Black" is met, your Life is reduced by 1. Then due to the Extra Rule on your Buzz holomem "If this holomem is downed, you get Life-2" your Life is reduced by another 2, for a total of 3 Life damage.

Question: My hBP01-043 Usada Pekora with a hBP01-123 Wild Rabbit Alliance attached uses the Arts "Operation: Bunnify Humanity". If I use the ability of Wild Rabbit Alliance, how many dice rolls to I re-roll?
Answer: Discard the results of all three dice rolls, and roll the die three times again.

Question: If my Life is at 2 or more, and my hBP01-014 Amane Kanata with an hBP01-116 Upao attached is downed by an Arts from my opponent's center holomem, can I deal Special Damage to my opponent's center holomem with Upao's ability?
Answer:
Yes, you can.
When Amane Kanata takes Damage, Upao's "when the holomem this mascot is attached to takes Damage" ability is activated and goes into standby.
After that, Amane Kanata and Upao are archived by the Down process, and the effect of Upao's ability in standby is resolved at the next check timing.

Question: My Buzz holomem hBP01-071 Omaru Polka is downed. If I then use hBP01-006 Takanashi Kiara's SP Oshi Skill "Rise from the Ashes", how much Life damage will I take?
Answer:
Omaru Polka's Extra text is a continuous ability with a replacement effect, so the Life damage when it is downed is 2.
Takanashi Kiara's SP Oshi Skill "Rise from the Ashes" reduces Life damage by 1, so the Life damage when this is used is 1.

Question: I archived 2 holo Power as the cost to use hBP01-006 Takanashi Kiara's Oshi Skill "Phoenix Tail". If one of them is a holomem, can I return that holomem from my archive to hand with the effect "Return 1 holomem from your archive to hand"?
Answer: Yes, you can. If there were no holomem in your archive and after archiving 2 holo Power as a cost there are still no holomem, the ability will resolve without doing anything.

Question: I used hBP02-001 Shirakami Fubuki's SP Oshi Skill "FBKINGDOM" while having 6 mascots on my stage, so I rolled a die 3 times and got 2 odd numbers. Will my opponent's Life be reduced by 2?
Answer: No, their Life will be reduced by 1. If you roll the die multiple times with "Fubukingdom", the opponent's Life will not be reduced by more than 1, no matter how many odd numbers you roll.

Question: Can I use hBP02-003 Houshou Marine's Oshi Skill "Ahoy!" even if Blooming a holomem with #Gen 3 was not my last action?
Answer: Yes, you can. As long as one of your holomem with #Gen 3 has Bloomed this turn, you can use the Oshi Skill at any time during your Main Step.

Question: When I reveal 3 cards using hBP02-004 Sakamata Chloe's Oshi Skill "Poe Poe Poe~", can I put some in my archive and return some to my deck?
Answer: No, you cannot. You must either archive all 3, or put all 3 back onto your deck.

Question: Can I use hBP02-006 Kureiji Ollie's SP Oshi Skill "Ollie Revives" even if I have 3 or less cards in my deck?
Answer: Yes, you can. In this case, draw until you have no cards in your deck, then archive 2 cards from your hand.

Question: Can I use hBP02-007 Mori Calliope's Oshi Skill "Sampling" even if I have no cards in my hand?
Answer: Yes, you can. However, since you could not archive 2 cards from your hand, the effect ends without doing anything.

Question: Can I use hBP02-007 Mori Callope's SP Oshi Skill "Reaper's Rap" during the Performance Phase?
Answer: No, you cannot. You must use this skill during your Main Phase.

Question: If I have used hBP02-007 Mori Calliope's SP Oshi Skill "Reaper's Rap" on my center Mori Calliope, if I have a holomem in the collab position can I use their Arts after the first use of my center holomem's Arts?
Answer: No, you cannot. If you have used the SP Oshi Skill "Reaper's Rap", the selected Mori Calliope must use their Arts twice in a row.

Question: When using hBP02-017 Shirogane Noel's Arts "Gen 3 Power", if there are 5 other holomem with #Gen 3 on my stage, does it still only count up to 4 of them?
Answer: Yes, it does. The number of holomem that can be counted is up to 4, excluding the Shirogane Noel using the Arts. Therefore the maximum Damage that can be gained is +80.

Question: Can I use hBP02-026 Ookami Mio's Bloom Effect "Grown as an Idol" to choose a holomem with #GAMERS, and then send a cheer from my cheer deck to a holomem of another color?
Answer: Yes, you can. The cheer you reveal from your cheer deck must be the same color as 1 of your holomem with #GAMERS, but can be freely sent to any of your holomem.

Question: Regarding hBP02-032 Houshou Marine's Bloom Effect "Houshou's Pirate Crew", how does the text "You may only use the Bloom Effect "Houshou's Pirate Crew" once per turn." differ from "[1/Turn]"?
Answer:
"[1/Turn]" indicates that the specific instance of that ability may only be used once on each turn, but the text of the Bloom Effect "Houshou's Pirate Crew" means that only one instance of any Bloom Effect with that name may be used on each turn.
For example, if hBP02-032 Houshou Marine is already on your stage and used its Bloom Effect this turn, then even if you Bloom another hBP02-032 Houshou Marine, the Bloom Effect will not activate.

Question: When using hBP02-049 Kureiji Ollie's Collab Effect "Ollie's Always Watching", do I archive a card from my hand even if there are no cards in my deck?
Answer: Yes, you do.

Question: Can I use hBP02-051 Kureiji Ollie's Bloom Effect "Going Full Fangirl!!" to bloom a holomem who has already bloomed this turn?
Answer: No, you cannot. Only holomem that have not yet bloomed this turn may Bloom using this ability.

Question: Regarding hBP02-051 Kureiji Ollie's Bloom Effect "Going Full Fangirl!!", how does the text "You may only use the Bloom Effect "Going Full Fangirl!!" once per turn." differ from "[1/Turn]"?
Answer:
"[1/Turn]" indicates that the specific instance of that ability may only be used once on each turn, but the text of the Bloom Effect "Going Full Fangirl!!" means that only one instance of any Bloom Effect with that name may be used on each turn.
For example, if hBP02-051 Kureiji Ollie is already on your stage and used its Bloom Effect this turn, then even if you Bloom another hBP02-051 Kureiji Ollie, the Bloom Effect will not activate.

Question:
hBP02-060 Yuzuki Choco's Bloom Effect "Seductive Gaze" states "Deal 10 Special Damage to your opponent's center holomem for each 10 HP restored by this effect."
If the target of the damage is a Shirogane Noel with a hBP02-100 Knight's Order of Shirogane attached, will the damage be reduced from 10 to 0 multiple times, no matter how much HP was restored?
Answer:
No, if the amount of HP restored by this effect was 50, then it will do a single instance of 50 Damage.
In this case, when used against a Shirogane Noel with a hBP02-100 Knight's Order of Shirogane attached, if the amount of HP restored was 50, then 50 Special Damage will be dealt, and then reduced by 10 to 40 Damage.

Question: Does hSD02-009 Nakiri Ayame's Arts "Tis I!" deal 40 special damage to my opponent's center holomem 3 times, if I archived 3 cards from my hand?
Answer: No, it does not. If you archive 3 cards from your hand, then it will do a total of 40 Damage for each in one single instance of 120 Special Damage.

Question: Can I use hBP02-076 Custom PC if I have no Debut holomem in my hand?
Answer: No, you cannot. When you play this card, you must "Reveal 1 Debut holomem from your hand, and return it to the bottom of the deck." Therefore, if you do not have any, you cannot use it.

Question: Can I use hBP02-077 Retro PC if there are no holomem in my Archive?
Answer: No, you cannot. Support Cards cannot be used if using them does not change the game state other than putting the Support Card in the archive.

Question: Can I use hBP02-078 Kanata Construction to put a hSD01-013 SorAZ into my hand?
Answer: Yes, you can.

Question: Does the text "Only 1 of your event with #Magic can be used each turn" on hBP02-079 Explosion Magic mean that only this card cannot be played more than once per turn?
Answer: No, that is incorrect. If you have used this card, it means that you cannot play any more Events with #Magic during this turn.

Question: Does the text "Only 1 of your event with #Magic can be used each turn" on hBP02-083 Magic Dresser mean that only this card cannot be played more than once per turn?
Answer: No, that is incorrect. If you have used this card, it means that you cannot play any more Events with #Magic during this turn.

Question: When using hBP02-084 Mikkorone 24, what happens if I roll a 1?
Answer: You draw 2 cards from your deck, and nothing else happens.

Question:
While I had a Murasaki Shion with a hBP02-087 Murasaki Shion's Magic Wand attached in my center position, I used hBP02-005 Murasaki Shion's Oshi Skill "Heeeyyyyy" twice. After that, the Murasaki Shion moved out of the center position, and back to the center position again.
Since the Oshi Skill became "1/Turn" before going back to "2/Turn" again, can I use it another time?
Answer: No, you cannot. Since the ability is changed specifically to "2/Turn", even if the Murasaki Shion with Murasaki Shion's Magic Wand attached leaves and returns to the center position, the number of times the Oshi Skill can be used does not increase.

Question: When using hBP02-097 UDIN's ability, do I archive a card from my hand even if there are no cards in my deck?
Answer: Yes, you do.

Question: When using hBP02-100 Knight's Order of Shirogane's ability "The holomem this fan is attached to takes -10 damage", if a single Arts deals both arts damage and special damage, does this apply to both resulting in a total reduction of 20 Damage?
Answer: Yes, each time damage is taken it is reduced by 10.

Question: When a holomem with hSD02-014 Poyoyo attached blooms, which happens first: that holomem's Bloom Effect, or Poyoyo's ability "When the holomem this mascot is attached to blooms, draw 1 card"?
Answer: Since these effects are triggered simultaneously, the player whose holomem is blooming may choose the order that they happen.

Question: When using hSD03-013 Oka-nyan's ability "The holomem this mascot is attached to in the center position or collab position takes -10 damage", if a single Arts deals both arts damage and special damage, does this apply to both resulting in a total reduction of 20 damage?
Answer: Yes, each time damage is taken it is reduced by 10.

Question: When a holomem with hSD04-014 Chocolat attached blooms, which happens first: that holomem's Bloom Effect, or Chocolat's ability "When the holomem this mascot is attached to blooms, restore 20 HP to this holomem"?
Answer: Since these effects are triggered simultaneously, the player whose holomem is blooming may choose the order that they happen.

Question: When using hBP02-006 Kureiji Ollie's Oshi Skill "Zombie Tactics", can I choose a holomem that was archived as part of the holo Power cost as the target of the skill?
Answer: Yes, you can.

Question: When using hBP02-007 Mori Calliope's Oshi Skill "Sampling", can I choose a holomem that was archived as part of the holo Power cost as the target of the skill?
Answer: Yes, you can.

Question: hSD02-012 Irohanihohetto AyaFubuMi says "This card can only be used if you have 6 or less cards in hand excluding this card." Does this include the case of having 6 cards?
Answer: Yes, it does.

Question: hSD03-012 Dorobo Construction says "This card can only be used if you have 6 or less cards in hand excluding this card." Does this include the case of having 6 cards?
Answer: Yes, it does.

Question: hSD04-012 SubaChocoLuna says "This card can only be used if you have 6 or less cards in hand excluding this card." Does this include the case of having 6 cards?
Answer: Yes, it does.

Question: Can I use hBP02-059 Mori Calliope's Bloom Effect "Soul Voice" and not reveal a card?
Answer: No, you cannot.

Question: Can I use hBP02-003 Houshou Marine's Oshi Skill "Ahoy!" on 1 of my holomem with #Gen 3 that has not yet bloomed this turn?
Answer: No, you cannot. To use this Oshi Skill, you must select a holomem that has already bloomed this turn.

Question: After using hBP02-006 Kureiji Ollie's SP Oshi Skill "Ollie Revives", can I continue to bloom using holomem from my archive?
Answer: No, you cannot. The ability to bloom from your archive is only used as part of the Oshi Skill: you draw 4, archive 2, then may bloom from archive once.

Question: If I have a hBP02-059 Mori Calliope in both my center and collab position, can I use hBP02-007 Mori Calliope's SP Oshi Skill "Reaper's Rap" to select the Mori Calliope in the collab position?
Answer: Yes, you can.

Question: Does hBP02-040 Sakamata Chloe's Gift "Top-Tier Hell Yeah!" reduce my opponent's life by 1 if the three cards revealed by the Arts "holoX Slots" were support cards?
Answer: No, it does not. Support cards do not have a Bloom Level, so they did not match and you do not reduce your opponent's life by 1.

Question: Does hBP02-040 Sakamata Chloe's Gift "Top-Tier Hell Yeah!" reduce my opponent's life by 1 if the three cards revealed by the Art "holoX Slots" were a 1st, 1st, and 1st Buzz holomem?
Answer: Yes, it does. Since Buzz is not a Bloom Level, it is counted as a 1st holomem and it matches.

Question: Can I use hBP02-046 Murasaki Shion's Bloom Effect "Magic that Interchanges" to return a card with #Magic that I archived from my hand as part of the cost, back to my hand immediately?
Answer: Yes, you can.

Question: When using hBP02-084 Mikkorone 24, if I roll a 2 or 4 must I always draw an additional card?
Answer: Yes, you must draw the additional card.

Question:
While I had a Murasaki Shion with a hBP02-087 Murasaki Shion's Magic Wand attached in my center position, I used hBP02-005 Murasaki Shion's Oshi Skill "Heeeyyyyy" once. After that, the Murasaki Shion moved out of the center position.
Can I use the Oshi Skill "Heeeyyyyy" a second time?
Answer: No, you cannot. However, if the Murasaki Shion with Murasaki Shion's Magic Wand attached returns to the center position, then you can use the Oshi Skill a second time.

Question: If my hBP02-012 Shirakami Fubuki with a hBP02-089 Oruyanke attached Collabs, can I place the holo Power and use the ability of Oruyanke in any order I like?
Answer: No, you cannot. The process for Collabing is to place a holo Power then move your selected holomem to the collab position, so you must place a holo Power first then process Oruyanke's ability.

Question: If my hBP02-013 Shirakami Fubuki with a hBP02-089 Oruyanke and a hBP02-091 Fubu-chun attached Collabs, which ability is processed first: Oruyanke or Fubu-chun?
Answer: Since these effects are triggered simultaneously, you may choose the order that they happen.

Question: When using hBP02-092 Fubzilla's ability, can I only archive cheers from the holomem with Fubzilla attached?
Answer: No, you may archive any 2 cheers on your stage.

Question: When archiving cheers as part of hBP02-092 Fubzilla's ability, can I archive a hSD03-013 Oka-nyan attached to my hSD03-008 Nekomata Okayu?
Answer: No, Oka-nyan can only be archived as part of an ability of the holomem it is attached to, so it cannot be archived by Fubzilla.

Question: When a holomem with a hBP02-101 Mio-fam attached is downed, which comes first: sending a cheer from life, or drawing a card using Mio-fam's ability?
Answer: Drawing a card comes first.

Question: If I use hSD04-013 Choco's Omurice on a holomem without #Cooking, does it not gain Arts+20, even if there is another holomem with #Cooking on my stage?
Answer: No, that is incorrect. As long as there is a holomem with #Cooking on your stage, it will gain Arts+20.

Question: When using hBP02-005 Murasaki Shion's SP Oshi Skill "Shion's Amazing Magic", at what point is the number of cheers on my opponent's center holomem checked?
Answer: The number of cheers is checked after your purple center holomem uses its Arts and inflicts Arts Damage on your opponent's holomem.

Question: Can I use hBP02-006 Kureiji Ollie's Oshi Skill "Zombie Tactics" to Bloom a holomem that was put on stage this turn, or who has already Bloomed this turn?
Answer: No, you cannot.

Question: Can I use hBP02-006 Kureiji Ollie's SP Oshi Skill "Ollie Revives" to Bloom a holomem that was put on stage this turn, or who has already Bloomed this turn?
Answer: No, you cannot.

Question:
While I have a hBP02-040 Sakamata Chloe in both my center and collab position, I used the center Sakamata Chloe's Arts "holoX Slots" and revealed three holomem of the same Bloom level.
This gave my opponent -1 Life due to the Gift "Top-Tier Hell Yeah!", but does my opponent get another -1 Life due to my collab holomem's Gift "Top-Tier Hell Yeah!"?
Answer: No, they do not. The Gift "Top-Tier Hell Yeah!" refers to "this holomem's Arts", meaning the "holoX Slots" used by another of your holomem does not trigger the Gift.

Question: Can I use hBP02-057 Mori Calliope's Bloom Effect "We'll Make This the Best fes" to archive a holomem with the tags #EN #Singing and one with the tags #JP #Singing?
Answer: Yes, you can. They only need to share at least one tag, not all tags.

Question: Can I use hSD04-013 Choco's Omurice on a holomem whose HP hasn't been decreased?
Answer: No, you cannot.

Question:
During my turn I dealt damage to my opponent's Amane Kanata with hBP01-116 Upao attached, causing my center holomem to be downed. I then ended turn with only a collab holomem, and no back holomem to move to the center position.
Do I start my opponent's turn without a center holomem?
Answer: Yes, when your opponent's turn begins you will only have a collab holomem, without a center holomem being set.

Question: If one of my Shirakami Fubuki has a hBP02-089 Oruyanke attached and only 10 HP remaining, can I use hBP02-012 Shirakami Fubuki's Bloom Effect "Gonna Move You a Little" to attach the Oruyanke to another Shirakami Fubuki?
Answer: Yes, you can. If the amount of damage a holomem has received is equal to or more than its max HP after moving the mascot, it is downed.

Question: Can I look at the cards in my holo Power?
Answer: No, you cannot look at them unless a card specifically allows you to.

Question: If the opponent has used hBP01-005 Takane Lui's SP Oshi Skill "Hawkeye" during their previous turn, and I have no collab holomem, can I Collab?
Answer: Yes, you can.

Question: When my holomem with hSD06-011 Chakimaru attached is downed with damage, can I use Chakimaru's "when the holomem this tool is attached to takes damage" ability and deal special damage to my opponent's holomem?
Answer: Yes, you can.

Question: Does hSD07-004 Shiranui Flare's Arts "Wonderful Life" get +10 if I have the same number of cards in hand as my opponent?
Answer: No, it does not.

Question: Do I put a card into holo Power when using hSD07-007 Shiranui Flare's Bloom Effect "I've Grown Once Again" to move into the collab position?
Answer: No, you do not.

Question: Can I use hSD07-007 Shiranui Flare's Bloom Effect "I've Grown Once Again" to move it into the collab position even if it is resting?
Answer: Yes, you can.

Question: After using hSD07-007 Shiranui Flare's Bloom Effect "I've Grown Once Again" while resting, during the next reset phase is the holomem still resting?
Answer: Yes. During the reset phase it will be set to active, before moving to the back position and resting again.

Question: Does hSD07-012 Omaru Polka's Collab Effect "Give Us Water" allow me to draw a card if I have the same number of cards in hand as my opponent?
Answer: No, it does not.

Question: Can I use hBP03-001 Himemori Luna's Oshi skill "I Know How to Use a Computew!" if there are no cards with "PC" in their card name in my deck?
Answer: Yes. In this case you pay the holo Power cost and look inside your deck, but since there are no cards with "PC" in the card name to add to hand, you shuffle your deck without adding any.

Question: Can I use hBP03-001 Himemori Luna's SP Oshi skill "Lu-knights, Assemble" if I have four copies of hBP03-105 Lu-knights in my archive?
Answer: Yes. In this case you pay the holo Power cost and look inside your deck, but since there are no Lu-knightss in the deck, you shuffle your deck without attaching any.

Question: Can I attach a hBP03-105 Lu-knights that I revealed using hBP03-001 Himemori Luna's SP Oshi skill "Lu-knights, Assemble" to 1 of my holomem other than Himemori Luna?
Answer: No, you cannot.

Question: Can I use hBP03-002 Shishiro Botan's SP Oshi skill "Sniping" if my center holomem is White/Green?
Answer: Yes, you can.

Question: Can I use hBP03-003 Sakura Miko's Oshi skill "Are 35P Making a Comeback?!" even if I have no hBP03-107 35P in my archive?
Answer: Yes. In this case you pay the holo Power cost, and then if any 35P have been added to archive you may return them to your hand. If not, then the effect finishes resolving without anything else happening.

Question: Can I use hBP03-003 Sakura Miko's SP Oshi skill "The Strength to not Give Up" even if I have no cards in my hand?
Answer: Yes, you can.

Question: Can I use hBP03-004 FUWAMOCO's Oshi skill "Moco-chan!" to send a cheer to hBP03-050 FUWAMOCO?
Answer: Yes, you can. The Extra rule of hBP03-050 FUWAMOCO states that "This holomem is also regarded as <Fuwawa Abyssgard> <Mococo Abyssgard>" so it meets the condition.

Question: If I use hBP03-004 FUWAMOCO's SP Oshi skill "BAU BAU!" on 1 of my holomem, and my opponent has no center or collab holomem, can my holomem target 1 of my opponent's back holomem directly?
Answer: Yes, it can.

Question: If my opponent uses hBP01-087 Kobo Kanaeru's Arts "Rain Mantra" and two of my Inugami Korone are downed at the same time, can I use hBP03-006 Inugami Korone's SP Oshi skill "Wow Wow Wow Wow" to move the cheers from both of them, and return a holomem to my hand from both?
Answer: No, you cannot. Down processing is performed on one holomem at a time, so the skill can only be used on one holomem.

Question:
My hBP03-066 Inugami Korone is the third card in a stack (on top of a Debut and 1st holomem), and is downed during my opponent's turn.
If I use hBP03-006 Inugami Korone's SP Oshi skill "Wow Wow Wow Wow" to return one of these cards to hand, what are the cards I can choose between?
Answer: In this case you may choose any of the three cards (Debut, 1st, and hBP03-066) to return to your hand.

Question: Can I use hBP03-007 Tsunomaki Watame's Oshi Skill "Welcome to the Member Sheep!" if there are no fans in my deck?
Answer: Yes. In this case you pay the holo Power cost and look inside your deck, but since there are no fans to add to hand, you shuffle your deck without adding any.

Question: When using hBP03-012 Himemori Luna's Bloom Effect "Let's Make this the Best Concert Ever!" I selected my center holomem. After that I Baton Passed to another holomem, does the new center holomem have Arts+20?
Answer: No, it does not. Only the selected holomem gets Arts+20.

Question:
When using hBP03-012 Himemori Luna's Bloom Effect "Let's Make this the Best Concert Ever!" I selected hBP01-096 Usada Pekora with a hBP01-123 Wild Rabbit Alliance attached.
After this, I Collabed with that holomem, and during the Collab Effect "That is an "Adventure"" I re-rolled the die using the ability of hBP01-123 Wild Rabbit Alliance, causing it to be archived.
In this case, does hBP01-096 Usada Pekora still have Arts+20?
Answer: Yes, it does. If the selected holomem had a fan attached when selected as part of hBP03-012 Himemori Luna's Bloom Effect, it gains and keeps the Arts+20 even if it does not have a fan attached when using its Arts.

Question: Can I use hBP03-017 Shishiro Botan's Collab Effect "Prepare" to archive the top card of my cheer deck even if I have no holomem with reduced HP?
Answer: Yes, you can.

Question: Can I use hBP03-021 Shishiro Botan's Bloom Effect "Shishiro Botan will fix it somehow" to attach 2 cheers to 1 of my holomem with #Shooter?
Answer: No, you cannot. The Bloom Effect allows you to attach 1 cheer to each of up to 2 holomem, if you only choose 1 holomem then it can still only have 1 cheer attached.

Question: Does the text "your life cannot be reduced by your opponent's abilities" in hBP03-022 Aki Rosenthal's Gift "My Otherworldly Form" mean that my life is not reduced by my holomem being downed by special damage?
Answer: No, when your holomem are downed by special or Arts damage, your life is reduced as normal life damage. The only time it is not reduced is by abilities that use the text "life-X" in them.

Question:
When my opponent's performance phase started, I used hBP03-022 Aki Rosenthal's Gift "My Otherworldly Form".
Then hBP03-022 Aki Rosenthal was downed by an Arts used by my opponent's Shirakami Fubuki, and my opponent used hBP02-001 Shirakami Fubuki's SP Oshi skill "FBKINGDOM", rolled a die, and rolled an odd number.
In this case, does Aki Rosenthal's Gift "My Otherworldly Form" not activate, resulting in me taking 1 extra Life damage?
Answer: No, the Gift "My Otherworldly Form" is activated at the start of your opponent's performance phase and stays active for the entire turn even if Aki Rosenthal is downed.

Question: Does hBP03-023 Usada Pekora's Arts "Time to Play Cards Peko" gain +40 even if I've rolled a die as part of another Usada Pekora's Bloom Effect?
Answer: Yes, if any dice have been rolled as part of any Usada Pekora's ability this turn, the Arts gains +40.

Question: When using hBP03-033 Akai Haato's Bloom Effect "Gonna Give it my All!" on a holomem with a tool attached, do I deal 10 special damage and then 20 special damage?
Answer: No, you deal one instance of 30 special damage.

I used hBP01-081 Hoshimachi Suisei's Arts "Shining Comet" to down my opponent's center Amane Kanata, which had a hBP01-116 Upao attached.

In this case, when are the effects of each Upao processed?

The priority of effect processing is that all rule processes (such as the Down process) are executed first,
